review_locator: PMCID:PMC2683320, Mucin overproduction in chronic inflammatory lung disease; PMCID:PMC2729522, Th9 and allergic disease
primary_title: Allergen-induced IL-9 directly stimulates mucin transcription in respiratory epithelial cells
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows recombinant human IL-9 stimulates human MUC5AC mucin transcription in airway epithelial cells, with IL-9-receptor blockade reducing airway-fluid mucin activity; intratracheal mouse IL-9 also increases mucous-cell and Muc5ac output.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC5813811, Mast cells as sources of cytokines, chemokines and growth factors; PMCID:PMC3828627, Cellular sources and immune functions of interleukin-9
primary_title: IL-9 Induces VEGF Secretion from Human Mast Cells and IL-9/IL-9 Receptor Genes Are Overexpressed in Atopic Dermatitis
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-9 increases VEGF mRNA and secreted VEGF from human LAD2 mast cells, while STAT3 phosphorylation occurs rapidly and STAT3 inhibition blocks the release response.

primary_title: Distinct roles for STAT1, STAT3, and STAT5 in differentiation gene induction and apoptosis inhibition by interleukin-9
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-9-receptor mutants that activate STAT1/STAT3 induce granzyme A, whereas STAT5-restricted signaling does not, supporting a bounded IL-9 differentiation-gene output.
